quotes.text: Bug 1890731 rounds the PaneSplitter requested size to an integer before setting height or width. The author noted a fraction of a pixel cannot be used by this element, and AutoTreeView persists integer column widths. This keeps saved widths stable across resize and restore. Current pane-splitter.js should still be checked before using the old line as a code template.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.
